name: mfe-architecture
description: Micro frontend orchestration with single-spa + Webpack Module Federation

scripts.start: concurrently -n root,nav,dash,settings -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run start -w root-config" "npm run start -w @mfe/nav" "npm run start -w @mfe/dashboard" "npm run start -w @mfe/settings"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mfe/nav && npm run build -w @mfe/dashboard && npm run build -w @mfe/settings && npm run build -w root-config
